## Route gate

- allowlist entries: 427 (routes not yet migrated to declared policies; 37 routes already declare)
- retired keys: 0 (monotonic shrink — entries can only move to `retired`, never return)
- a new route without a declared policy or an entry fails CI (`tests/test_authz_route_gate.py`)

## Access-scope taxonomy

`system` covers every tenant; `tenant` is one tenant; `own` is the caller's own records; `grant` is reach through an active care-team grant; break-glass is the audited, time-boxed `access_elevations` widening, never a role permission.
